## Orientation

Worktree only: `/home/andrewyin/affidavit--atomic-claims` on branch `phase/atomic-claims`. Do not edit `.artifacts/`. Do not call `adaptive-artifacts`. After code lands, commit excluding `.artifacts`:
`git add -A -- . ':!.artifacts' && git commit -m "tests-claim-chain"`
Return evidence with that commit SHA as `revision`.

Territory: `tests/test_plan_trace.py` and helpers needed for skill extraction / CLI thin-shape tests. Do not edit skills or contract (already landed). Solo wave.

Contract + skills already on this branch (f9d7371, 464d681). plan-trace currently fails on old omit-when-no-spec assertions — rewrite to match new skills.

TDD: expect a failing run first, then green. Name a test `criterion_optional_in_contract` and a CLI thin-deliver create/capture test whose name matches verify filters (`thin_deliver` and capture/create/cli).

### Requirements

R6: `tests/test_skill_contract_consistency.py` and `tests/test_plan_trace.py` (and any skill examples they extract) enforce R1–R5. No adaptive-artifacts extension change. No close-batch refusal for missing requirement or non-empty criterion in this phase.

### Design Invariants / Assumptions / Decisions

As in atomic-claims design; enforcement is skills+contract+tests only.
